Resolution criteria:
- "Athletics": Wins if the Athletics record an official win against the Kansas City Royals in their MLB game played on August 20, 2026, per the official final score.
- "Kansas City Royals": Wins if the Kansas City Royals record an official win against the Athletics in their MLB game played on August 20, 2026, per the official final score.

Clarifications:
- If the game is postponed and not completed on August 20, 2026 (UTC), the market resolves based on the completed make-up game result; if the game is cancelled with no result, the market is considered unresolvable.
